title.narrative: Fourth Greater Mekong Subregion Corridor Towns Development Project

description.narrative: The project will support the government of the Lao PDR in improving urban environmental services and enhance regional economic connectivity in the towns of Paksan and Thakhek, two towns located along the North-South Economic Corridor in the Greater Mekong Subregion (GMS). It will finance: (i) sewage networks and eight small-scale wastewater treatment facilities to improve sanitation; (ii) two controlled landfills and solid waste collection vehicles for municipal waste to improve waste collection and management, (iii) improved drainage and riverbank protection, (iv) rehabilitation of the old-town center to promote regional tourism in Thakhek, and; (v) city master plans to promote regional economic connectivity. The project will accelerate urban node development along the GMS North-South Economic Corridor in Lao PDR.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Grant 0606: 73% of contracts awarded and 40% disbursed as of 01 Jul 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: Procurement activities in various stages for all civil works packages. To date, 7 civil works packages have been awarded and two packages, Paksan Strom water drainage and Paksan Municipal solid waste were completed. 3 remaining civil works packages are under bid evaluation (Thakek Zone B) and in the process of notice for awarding the contracts (Thankek Non-Zone B and Thakek urban renewal).
Grant closing date has been extended from 30 June 2024 to 30 June 2026 (24 months).
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Aug 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50099/50099-003-apfs-en_4.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Sep 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50099/50099-003-iee-en_12.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Jan 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50099/50099-003-rp-en_8.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Sep 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50099/50099-003-smr-en_15.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Achieved. PCU has 15 staff, including 8 women (53.3%).
Achieved. The PIUs have 29 staff, including 15 women (51.7%). Women's representation in Thakhek and Paksan are 53.8% (7/13) and 50.0% (8/16), respectively.
Being implemented. The UDMP support consultant contract was signed on 11 Nov 2022. The updated inception report was completed and submitted on 28 Mar 2023. Topographic survey was completed. The Consultant is now preparing the draft Master plan and the 1st consultation workshop was held in the end of Nov 2023 and the 2nd consultation workshop was held in July 2024. The final D5-D6 products of UDMP for Paksan and Thakhek submitted in August 2024.
Being implemented. The project training masterplan has been developed. The PIC has conducted 12 on-the-job training courses for PCU, PIUs, and Contractors.
Being implemented. The survey for collecting data for tariff roadmap, O&M and CP was conducted in July 2022. The Tariff Road Map and Corporate Plan (including for O&M fund) preparation is ongoing.
Not yet due. Subprojects are still under construction.
Being implemented. The Paksan and Thakhek Stormwater Drainage have been awarded on 29 Nov 2021 and 1 Sep 2022, respectively. At of end of March 2025, physical progress for Paksan and Thakhek are 100% and 93.97%, respectively.
Being implemented. Paksan subproject (DWAT-CW02/Lot 1) contract has been awarded on 2 August 2023. Thakhek subproject (DWAT-CW02/Lot 2) contract has been awarded on 29 November 2022. Physical progress is 47.42% and 98.03% respectively by end of March 2025.
Being implemented. The Paksan DEWATS -CW02-Lot 1)was awarded on 2 Aug 2023, with 47.42 % work progress. Thakhek DEWATS was awarded on 29 Nov 2022, with actual construction progress of 98.03% by end of March 2025.
Being implemented. The Paksan and Thakhek Municipal Solid Waste have been awarded on 29 Jan 2021 and 24 Dec 2021, respectively. At the end of March 2024, physical progress for Paksan and Thakhek are 100% and 99.42%, respectively.
Being implemented. The Paksan Riverbank Protection subproject was awarded on 3 Apr 2023 to Supthavy Construction Sole Co. Ltd, with actual construction progress of 14.16% by end of Dec 2024 and EA proposed termination of contract and rebidding using 1S1E. The draft rebidding document submitted to ADB on 17 April 2025. Subproject in Thakhek (RB-CW04-Lot 2) had been splitted into 2 packages. Package RB-CW04-Lot 2 (None Zone B) called for bid on 28 August 2023 and closed on 12 October 2023 and. ADB issued to no objection letter to award to the responsive bidder on 20 March 2025. Package RB-CW04-Lot 3 (Zone B) called for Bid on 26 April 2024 and was closed on 11 June 2024 and this package is under technical bid evaluation.
The pre-design was completed in Aug 2022. The public consultation meeting and DED presentation to local authorities/people was completed in May 2023. The draft BD was submitted in Sep 2024 and BD (1S1E) has been finalized by end of Dec 2024 and IFB was advertised on 13 Jan 2023. Bid opening on 17 Feb 2025 and submission of formal BER to ADB for issuance of Nobjection.
